answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 172657 Country: India Title: MIQAT FROM BAHRAIN Question: We are going to hajj this year from Mumbai, and our flight if via Bahrain (stay at Bahrain 5 or 6 hours). Please confirm where we should wear ihram, Mumbai or Bahrain and where will be Miqat for us? Answer ID: 172657 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1245/1083/D=12/1440) If it is a direct flight from Mumbai to Bahrain then you need not to wear Ihram from Mumbai. The Miqat of Bahrain people will be same as yours. You should ask them what is their Miqat from Bahrain to Jeddah rather it is better if you wear ihram from Bahrain. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
